title: Sign-up with the real access code works
instructions: On https://christian-friends-hub.vercel.app/signup, create an account with your own email and the current community access code. You should land in the hub. Afterwards remove the test account from Admin → Access.

title: A volunteer request reaches the coordinators
instructions: Not automated because it emails the real coordinators/deacons. Tell them first, then submit a clearly marked test request on /volunteer and confirm the coordinator email arrives. Remove the request afterwards.

title: Posting a prayer request works
instructions: Not automated because members would see it. Post a clearly marked test prayer request, confirm it appears on /prayer-requests, then delete it.
